page.layout: One page of text in italic verse, single column; running head at top; page number top left; catchword "Sitque" at lower right, set apart; several small marginal marks (dashes, commas) at the margins but no marginal notes.

main_text.l: Nec si quis olim stimulus ingenio additus
Natura mentem vegeto adhuc in corpore
Nam si quid olim effœta mens felicius
Cui nostra Musa dedicata est, debeo,
Hæc est Thalia nostra, nostri pectinis
Qua sola Phœbo digna cantat, & cani
Aut alia si qua barbito Phœbi parem
Quòd si Deárum utrinque mentes copulet
Sermone qui nunc vix pedestri repo humi,

page.notes: Several faint ink marks and specks in the margins (e.g. near lines 9, 13, 21 and at the bottom) are not printed text. The catchword "Sitque" is printed at the lower right, underlined. Some letters are uncertain due to the italic type and scan quality, notably "Deárum", "barbito" and "Peioris ævi aheneis".
